status.evidence: According to UK Companies House records, Asset Monitoring Solutions Limited (Company No. 04588014) was dissolved on 23 February 2013 following liquidation, while the active brand entity Asset Monitoring Solution Group (UK) Limited has been controlled by Ram Tracking Acquisition Limited since 2020.

Asset Monitoring Solutions Ltd.label: Asset Monitoring Solutions Ltd (subsidiary of RAM Tracking)

claims.claim: Asset Monitoring Solutions reports providing telemetry solutions to BT, serving 1,000 customers with 10,000 installed trackers, utilizing multi-network roaming SIM cards to ensure network coverage across the United Kingdom [1.2.3].

Asset Monitoring Solutions reports that its hardware devices, such as the AMS Fleet Manager +, feature high-gain GSM and GNSS internal antennas to collect location coordinates globally and transfer them via cellular networks to its central server [1.2.1, 1.2.11].
claims.corrected: Asset Monitoring Solutions reports that its hardware devices, such as the AMS Fleet Manager +, feature high-gain GSM and GNSS internal antennas to collect location coordinates globally and transfer them via GSM networks to its central server.

claims.claim: The company reports working as an integration partner with DHL to interface with their TripMonitor data feed system for exact vehicle location tracking, according to the Asset Monitoring Solutions website.

The company reports that it provides telemetry solutions to British Telecommunications (BT) as part of a total customer base exceeding 1,000 clients, according to the Asset Monitoring Solutions website.
The company offers the AMS OBD tracking device, a plug-and-play unit designed for direct connection to a vehicle's onboard diagnostics port with an extender cable for self-installation.
The company reports a large-scale deployment providing fleet telemetry systems to BT as part of an aggregate footprint across 1,000 customers and 10,000 tracking devices.
The company reports an integration with Telerivet's cloud-based platform utilizing a Webhook API to automatically trigger real-time vehicle alerts directly from its tracking servers.
The company reports serving 1,000 customers with 10,000 installed trackers and providing telemetry to BT, according to the Asset Monitoring Solutions "About Us" page.

The company reports that it operates as an integration partner with DHL, working directly with their TripMonitor data feed system to deliver precise location data, according to the Asset Monitoring Solutions website.
Asset Monitoring Solutions Ltd was acquired by telematics provider RAM Tracking on 01-Oct-2020.
The company reports that it operates as an integration partner with DHL, collaborating with the logistics provider's TripMonitor data feed system to deliver precise location data.

A distribution and sales alliance established between 2006 and 2011 introduced a partnership with British Telecom's Field Force Automation division, which expanded channel distribution to major commercial fleets such as Northumbrian Water.
The company reports operating as an integration partner with DHL to supply exact location tracking data integrated with the DHL TripMonitor data feed system.

The company reports operating its physical headquarters from Unit 8, Gamma Terrace, Masterlord Office Village, Ransomes Industrial Estate in Ipswich, United Kingdom, where it hosts its in-house customer support, engineering, and sales teams.
